title: Extcap: Add dissector for extcap_example.py
description:
Adding a dissector for dissection of the example data
for extcap_example.py

notes.body: I couldn't merge this branch: Insufficient approvals (have: [] missing: 1)

I don't think we should add this dissector, even if it's disabled, because it's only an example.

If we should add it I will suggest making it a Lua dissector which we will provide as an example for a good and well written Lua dissector, which can be used to dissect the extcap example protocol.
